'''February 2001 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 3 February 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1761">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-21-parker-co-2-3-01-calm-before-the-stormd1761/ parker-co-2-3-01-calm-before-the-storm], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 21 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-21-parker-co-2-3-01-calm-before-the-stormd1761/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 26
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
